javascript: Transitive imports of web/platform/runtime.js and web/wasm/worker.js, with patches/0003-papers3-battery-host.patch initializing the PaperS3 battery ADC through the existing host analog script. Catalog reduced to PaperS3. No hardware flasher or Web Serial writer included. Patches 0004/0005 also version the WASM URL to refresh cached engines.

wasm.sourceBuild: Locally rebuilt from sourceCommit with patches 0001, 0002, 0004 and 0005 (CPU/display changes); Rust 1.99.1, wasm32-unknown-unknown, upstream tools/wasm-build.sh. Host patches 0003/0004/0005 are applied to the vendored runtime.

firmware.name: EDCBook 3.1.2
firmware.storage: Downloaded directly by the user browser; not included in this repository.

support.runtime: Actual ESP32-S3 ROM, bootloader and application execution; display from guest peripheral transactions; GT911 single-touch and virtual SPI SDHC.
limitations: PaperS3 black/white digital display endpoints; 16-gray optical integration is incomplete.
RTC, buzzer audio and physical power button are not emulated.
Network connectivity and arbitrary firmware compatibility are not verified.

EDCBook3.1.2.result: Actual welcome screen, built-in quick-start guide, and next-page touch verified in browser. Firmware unmodified.

virtualBattery.result: Original uploaded BIN retains an identical welcome display through 125 guest seconds with no low-battery shutdown. Existing manifest scripts remain intact after the default battery script.

verification.regressions: 57 Xtensa tests; 246 S3 library tests; official UserDemo browser boot, actual touches, pause/resume, local BIN validation and fullscreen.

pageTurnPerformance.result: ABBA, two guide-page turns per fresh run; matching body hashes across all runs. Host-specific sample, not a hardware-speed claim. 57 Xtensa tests, native Xtensa Clippy and WASM jit-tests Clippy pass.

refreshJit.result: ABBA real EDCBook turns, identical reading-body hashes and 49 guest display scans per turn; 117938 WASM differential cases and 24 GPIO waveform cases pass; WASM Clippy passes. No firmware, panel optical-model or guest timing changes.

officialDemo.storage: Downloaded directly by the user browser; not included in this repository.

virtualBattery.transport: Existing WASM load kind6 host script: 0 adc 3 2.0. Actual SAR conversion and guest firmware battery logic remain active. Existing manifest scripts are prepended with the default and retain later overrides.
